subject: FIELD DELTA: cover/front animation can begin before INNER panel is visibly powered; wake latency remains user-visible
body: Human field observation: at times the front/cover animation begins while the main INNER screen has not yet powered on, and INNER illumination is noticeably too slow. Current-main source audit at 7127c287a17fd97050c98fbeb05a38f7318f2f64 confirms WakeInner currently traverses Fold7ContinuityCoordinator -> ShizukuBridge.wakeInnerDisplay -> DuoShellService.wakeInnerPhysicalDisplay, whose decisive action is a hidden SurfaceControl.setDisplayPowerMode(token, 2) on the resolved physical INNER display. That receipt proves only the physical power request boundary; it does not by itself prove Samsung device-state/logical-route transition, composition opportunity, first presentation, or useful pixels. This directly matches the observed possibility of animation advancing before INNER visibility. Do not promote this as root cause until same-attempt monotonic field telemetry joins physical-power request/result to device-state, logical display state, SurfaceFlinger/presentation and first useful pixel. Also note overlap: two child sessions have already published SESSION_STARTED for ticket 02-p0-inner-wake-causal-chain (rnd-innerwake-sol-e3521c95fe02 and rnd-p0-inner-sol-7127c287-e3ce2e4a); this chat is not claiming a third duplicate ticket and is contributing this bounded field/source delta for reconciliation.
